title: A Snake With No Wings Glides 24 Meters Through the Air
subject: flying snake

scenes.text: A snake with no wings or legs jumps off a tree and flies. How?
Flying snakes in Asia have been filmed gliding up to 24 meters from a 15 meter tower.
Mid-air, it sucks in its belly and spreads its ribs, flattening its body like a frisbee.
That curves the underside, so air pressure builds below and the snake gets lift.
It also whips side to side in an S shape, which helps keep it steady in the air.
Scientists say it never settles into a perfect glide. But a snake that can steer in the air still beats falling.
